title: Moses and Pharaoh – First Meeting
description: Moses and Aaron go to Pharaoh and ask him to let the people of Israel go free. Pharaoh refuses, calls the people lazy, and increases forced labor by refusing them straw for making bricks. The people complain to Moses, but God promises to deliver them with a strong hand and reminds them of His covenant with their ancestors.
